messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Rollout to prod:eu paused automatically due to incident 'kvcache-ejection-spike'. Holding all release windows for prod:eu. Ticket #INC-2026. @eng-releases please acknowledge :warning:
amy-plat: acked. I'm rolling back my feature rollout and stopping scheduled canaries. Will update release notes queue. :white_check_mark:
ben-release: thanks amy. staging traffic looks normal. is this constrained to eu region or cross-region?
andrew_ops: it's primarily eu-prod GPU hosts causing KV cache pressure; noisy-neighbor eviction spike coincided with our canary burst. investigating host flapping (kernel OOM logs). estimate 35-50m for root cause and mitigation.
marta-eng: can we pin the queued job images to previous model-serving tag (v1.12.3) so they don't drift when we resume? I'll queue an immediate pin if ops confirms rollback window.
julie_sre: rolling back last eu rollout (2026-03-20T15:10Z) is low risk; it reverts a single config change to kvcache_max_entries. Recommend rollback to lift hold faster.
amy-plat: what's the rollback command?
ben-release: we use deploy-bot for that; sample:```
deploy-bot /rollback --env prod:eu --to-tag v1.12.2 --reason "kvcache-ejection spike"
```
andy_ops: (andrew_ops) I'll approve and kick off the rollback if you want me to. Once rollback completes we'll run a short validation: 10% traffic for 15m, watch p95 token latency and cache miss rate.
marta-eng: pinning now: tagging queued pipelines with image:v1.12.3 and adding a note to release notes draft. sam-docs will you update the rollout blurb?
sam-docs: yep, I'll add a short note in the release channel and mark the PR as "on hold - incident".
julie_sre: rollback started by deploy-bot. progress updates below. :rocket:
deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id: rb-3291). ETA ~8m.
deploy-bot: rollback job succeeded. verification job running.
andrew_ops: verification looks good so far — KV eviction rate down, p95 latency back within SLO. continuing to monitor for 20m then we can discuss resume.
ben-release: proposal: don't resume automatic rollouts for prod:eu until we confirm 60m steady-state. we can reschedule paused releases to the next safe window (US-friendly).
amy-plat: agreed. Please reschedule my rollout to next slot: 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC.
marta-eng: I'll update the release calendar and pin the versions. Also adding a rollback note to changelog.
julie_sre: holding final decision until 20:10Z monitor window completes. If stable, deploy-bot to resume with canary=5% for 30m then gradual ramp.
deploy-bot: HOLD lifted at 2420004689 for prod:eu (conditions met). Resume plan: canary=5% 30m -> 25% 30m -> full. All paused rollouts rescheduled per assigned windows. :white_check_mark:
amy-plat: thanks team. closing thread after documentation updates.
